items.source: An EntityCallback that gets invoked after an aggregate was converted from the database into an entity.
items.translation: 一个在将聚合从数据库转换为实体后调用的 EntityCallback。

items.source: Entity callback method invoked after an aggregate root was converted.
items.translation: 实体回调方法在聚合根转换后被调用。

items.source:
Entity callback method invoked after an aggregate root was converted. Can return either the same or a modified
instance of the domain object.
items.translation: 实体回调方法在聚合根转换后调用。可返回原始域对象实例或修改后的实例。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可以用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。

items.source: the converted and possibly modified aggregate.
items.translation: 经转换且可能经过修改的骨料。
